title: Reticora rule AST
description: The JSON rule language of the metamodel (MET-45, CH18). The schema root is a value rule: required, pattern, range and enum, combined with all; it checks one value. $defs/condition is a condition (WP-715): comparisons of a field (eq, ne, in, not_in, gt, gte, lt, lte, contains, empty, not_empty) combined with the logic nodes all (AND), any (OR) and not (exactly one rule); it is true or false for a record. Comparisons occur only in conditions, the value operators required, pattern, range and enum only in value rules. This condition grammar is the common form of metamodel conditions, guards and filters (CH18, MET-45): the fieldmeta conditional rules (visible_when, required_when, read_only_when, allowed_values_when) map onto it without loss; savedview.Expr stays the SQL filter compiler, WP-309 maps it onto this form and adds only the filter operators (e.g. like, exists). backend/internal/rules evaluates rules and conditions bindingly, frontend/src/rules evaluates the same AST for previews; api/rules.conformance.json holds the cases both must pass. Semantics of conditions (those of fieldmeta.Predicate): field is the key of an attribute definition or of a typed CI column; an absent field is null. empty holds for an empty value (see below; also an empty object). Two empty values are equal; otherwise numbers compare by value, also when one is sent as decimal text, and strings and booleans by their text; a non-empty array or object equals nothing. in holds when the value equals one of the values. gt, gte, lt and lte compare numbers (also decimal text) and are false for anything else. contains holds for a string containing the text of value or for an array with an element equal to value. all of no rules holds, any of no rules does not. Semantics of value rules: a value is empty when it is absent, null, a string of only whitespace or an empty array. required fails for an empty value; every other rule passes an empty value. pattern, range and enum apply to each element of an array value. String lengths count Unicode code points. Patterns use the common subset of RE2 and ECMAScript (no lookaround, no backreferences) and match anywhere unless anchored with ^ and $. Violation codes: required, pattern, pattern.type, range.min, range.max, range.type, enum. $defs/expr is an expression (WP-258, MET-10 computed): it yields a value instead of checking one, e.g. the value of a computed attribute. Its operators are separate from those of value rules and conditions: field (the value of an attribute of the record, or asset.<field> of the asset linked through ci.asset_id, one of warranty_end, purchase_date, purchase_cost, asset_tag, serial_number, status), literal (a string, number or boolean), add, sub, mul and div (numbers, also decimal text), today (the current date in the time zone of the evaluation, YYYY-MM-DD), days_between (the days from the first to the second date; a date is text YYYY-MM-DD, a timestamp counts with its date in the time zone), concat, lower and upper (text; numbers and booleans by their text) and coalesce (the first non-empty operand). Semantics of expressions: an empty input (absent, null or blank text), a value of the wrong kind, a date that cannot be read or a division by 0 make the whole expression empty, except within coalesce. The result type is number (arithmetic, days_between), string (concat, lower, upper), date (today), that of the literal or asset field, the common type of the operands of coalesce, or any for an attribute of the record. Only backend/internal/rules evaluates expressions for now (EvalExpr).

all.description: Every rule must hold; violations are reported in order.

required.description: The value must not be empty (code required).

pattern.description: A string value must match the regular expression (code pattern; a non-string value: pattern.type).

range.description: The number (of: value) or the length of a string (of: length) lies within min and max, inclusive (codes range.min, range.max; a value of another kind: range.type).

enum.description: The value is one of the values; strings, numbers and booleans compare by type and value (code enum).

expr.description: An expression (WP-258): yields a value for the values of a record; empty inputs make it empty except within coalesce.

expr_field.description: The value of an attribute of the record (its key), or asset.<field> of the asset linked through ci.asset_id (whitelist rules.AssetFields).

expr_literal.description: A constant string, number or boolean.

expr_arithmetic.description: add and mul of two or more numbers, sub and div of exactly two (first minus/by second); division by 0 is empty.

expr_today.description: The current date in the time zone of the evaluation (YYYY-MM-DD).

expr_days_between.description: The number of days from the first to the second date (negative when the second is earlier).

expr_concat.description: The text of the operands joined without separator.

expr_case.description: The text of the one operand in lower or upper case.

expr_coalesce.description: The first operand that is not empty; empty when all are.

condition.description: A condition (WP-715): true or false for the values of a record.

condition_all.description: AND: every condition holds (no conditions: true).

any.description: OR: at least one condition holds (no conditions: false).

not.description: NOT: the one condition does not hold.

compare.description: A comparison of the value of field (fieldmeta.Predicate). empty and not_empty take no value; in and not_in a non-empty array of strings, numbers and booleans; gt, gte, lt and lte a number; eq, ne and contains a string, number or boolean.
